name: Edisto Beach
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Edisto Beach, SC 2026
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas on Edisto Beach, SC: Christmas tree lighting and sing along, Creche Festival and the Christmas Parade on Palmetto Boulevard.
lede: Edisto Beach keeps Christmas small town and easygoing, with a tree lighting at Bay Creek Park, a free Creche Festival and a golf cart friendly parade down Palmetto Boulevard.
celebrates: The Town of Edisto Beach lights its Christmas tree at Bay Creek Park on Sunday, November 29, with a sing along from 5:30 to 7 pm. The weekend after Thanksgiving, Edisto Island United Methodist Church shows more than 150 miniature nativity scenes at its Creche Festival. Christmas weekend follows on December 11 and 12, with a Holiday Market at Bay Creek Park on Friday and the Edisto Christmas Parade down Palmetto Boulevard at 2 pm on Saturday. The 2026 parade theme is A Very Vintage Christmas. The Edisto Chamber of Commerce and the Town share the calendar, and EdistoBeach.com also lists a community chorus Christmas concert on December 6.
lastyear: The Edisto Chamber of Commerce wrote up the island's 35th annual Christmas Parade in January 2026. Its theme was Seashells and Sleigh Bells, a coastal twist on Christmas that inspired beachy details, ocean inspired decor, festive bells and lots of candy. Earlier chamber recaps describe nearly thirty participants in one year, Santa Claus riding along, and more than 50 entries in another, so the parade has grown into a main event for the island's holiday season.
facts: The chamber's holiday calendar for 2026 also lists a Jubilee Artfest and Holiday Open House at the Edisto Island Museum on November 28, marking the museum's 40th birthday, and a Party at the Park at Bay Creek Park on November 27 with music by The Swinging Medallions. EdistoBeach.com says Christmas weekend is held the second Friday and Saturday of December, and calls it small town and golf cart friendly, with mild coastal weather for a December beach weekend.
trains: Edisto Beach has no Christmas train ride on our pages. On the island itself, the tree lighting, the Creche Festival and the parade are the main holiday events, and EdistoBeach.com calls the island golf cart friendly. For a real holiday train, see our South Carolina Christmas train ride guide. In Charleston, the Best Friend Train Museum on Ann Street shows a 1928 replica of the 1830 Best Friend locomotive, with free admission, and is listed in our museum guide.
train_links: A 1928 replica of the 1830 Best Friend locomotive in downtown Charleston, with free admission.
traditions: Christmas Tree Lighting and Sing Along
The Town of Edisto Beach lights its tree at Bay Creek Park with a community sing along.
Edisto Island United Methodist Church shows more than 150 miniature nativity scenes, with free admission.
A Palmetto Boulevard parade with decorated golf carts, floats, fire trucks and candy for the kids.
A Friday market of local vendors at Bay Creek Park on December 11.
The Edisto Community Chorus holds a Christmas concert on December 6, according to EdistoBeach.com.
kidfact: Edisto's Christmas parade has rolled down Palmetto Boulevard for more than 30 years, and the island's chamber has counted a Santa Claus on some of the floats.
faq: When is the Edisto Beach Christmas Parade in 2026?

The parade steps off at 2 pm on Saturday, December 12, 2026, on Palmetto Boulevard. The 2026 theme is A Very Vintage Christmas. Watching is free, and parking along the route fills early, so plan to arrive well before 2 pm.
When is the Edisto Beach tree lighting?
The Town of Edisto Beach holds its Christmas tree lighting and sing along at Bay Creek Park on Sunday, November 29, 2026, from 5:30 to 7 pm. Bay Creek Park is at 3706 Docksite Road.
Is there a Christmas market on Edisto?

The Edisto Chamber and the Town list a Holiday Market at Bay Creek Park on Friday, December 11, from 10 am to 4 pm. It is a vendor market, so we do not list it as a kids event, but it sits right before the parade.
Are there Christmas train rides on Edisto?
No. Edisto Beach has no Christmas train ride listed. Our South Carolina Christmas train ride guide lists options elsewhere in the state.
Are there Christmas Eve services for families on Edisto?
We do not have a Christmas Eve services page for Edisto Beach yet. The Edisto Chamber of Commerce keeps a holiday happenings page that lists church events.
